Microsoft Patch Tuesday update for May 2026 addresses 60 vulnerabilities, including
CVE-2026-12001, a critical Windows remote code execution vulnerability that is actively
exploited in the wild. The flaw resides in the Windows Print Spooler service and allows
unauthenticated remote code execution with SYSTEM privileges.

Affected products: Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2022, Windows 10, Windows 11.
A proof of concept has been published on GitHub. The CVE has been added to the CISA KEV
catalog.

Recommended actions: apply the May 2026 cumulative update. Hunt for spoolsv.exe spawning
unusual child processes (T1059.001).

Reach out to msrc@microsoft.com for additional guidance.
